name: Vámosatya (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vámosatya: a blue and red shield with a sun, a castle, a crescent and a bunch of grapes, above a blue scroll inscribed 1321 VÁMOSATYA 2002.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and blue triangles
